title: Infinite prime sumsets in structured and $U^k(Φ)$-uniform sets
summary: By introducing new ergodic-theoretic techniques in nilsystems, we determine which infinite sumset configurations occur in $U^k(Φ)$-uniform and Nil-Bohr sets. To be more precise, our first result associates the degree $k$ of a $U^k(Φ)$-uniform set with the variety of sumsets it contains, solving a conjecture of Kra, Moreira, Richter and Robertson. Restricting to Nil-Bohr sets we show the existence of infinite sumsets with summands in the shifted primes $\mathbb{P}-1$.
